candidate.title: sci-CAR
candidate.scope: The assigned central sci-CAR poster row, interpreted at its depicted two-round combinatorial-indexing implementation and clarified by the core sci-CAR workflow in Cao et al., Science 361(6409):1380-1385 (2018), PMID 30166440. Starts with a nuclei suspension containing poly(A) RNA and accessible chromatin; retains both targets in nuclei through first indexing, pooling and FACS redistribution; then synthesizes second-strand cDNA, lyses nuclei, divides each well lysate and constructs separate RNA and ATAC sequencing libraries. The upper scM&T-seq and lower scTrio-seq rows are neighboring catalogue context, outside this card's target. This describes assay architecture, not an execution recipe or every sci-CAR adaptation.
